prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a slow, steady movement forward along a dimly lit path on the Mardi Himal Trail in Kaski, Nepal, under a snowy night sky. The camera captures the gentle descent of snowflakes, which appear as small white specks against the dark, starless backdrop. As the viewer progresses, the terrain shifts subtly, revealing a mix of rocky patches and smoother, snow-covered ground. The camera angle remains relatively low, focusing on the immediate path ahead while occasionally panning slightly to the left and right, offering glimpses of the surrounding landscape. The faint glow from an unseen light source casts soft shadows, enhancing the texture of the snow and rocks. The environment is quiet and devoid of any other presence, emphasizing the solitude of the trail. The camera continues its forward motion, navigating through the undulating terrain, with the occasional tilt upward to capture the falling snow against the night sky. The overall ambiance is serene and isolated, with the continuous snowfall adding a layer of tranquility to the nocturnal journey.
